{
  "project_id": "P-GTM-SmartPublicFinances",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Fragmented and obsolete PFM information systems may cause integration failures and data inconsistencies.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Perform a detailed system audit, develop an interoperability roadmap, adopt open standards, and pilot integration modules before full rollout.",
      "evidence": "Section 9: Core PFM information systems suffer from fragmentation, obsolescence, and weak institutional support."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Cybersecurity attacks could compromise data integrity and disrupt essential public finance functions.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Establish an ISO‑27001‑based ISMS, create a CSIRT/SOC, conduct regular penetration testing, and implement incident‑response procedures.",
      "evidence": "Section 10: Cyberattacks on tax administration (2021), Foreign Ministry ransomware (2022), Guatecompras/SICOIN (2023) illustrate vulnerability."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Limited analytical capacity and data literacy among officials hinder effective use of data‑driven PFM.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Launch a structured training program, create data‑analytics career tracks, appoint data stewards, and provide mentorship and certification.",
      "evidence": "Section 10: Governments lack structured career paths and training for data analysts, limiting analytical capacity."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Low adoption of gender‑responsive budgeting limits inclusive outcomes.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Set mandatory gender‑budget tagging targets for all ministries, provide technical assistance to municipalities, and monitor compliance annually.",
      "evidence": "Section 7: Only 0.6% of budget gender‑tagged; 112 of 340 municipalities linked to CPEG."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Dependence on remittance‑driven fiscal revenues makes VAT collections vulnerable to external shocks.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Broaden tax base, improve collection efficiency, build fiscal buffers, and incorporate remittance trend monitoring into budgeting.",
      "evidence": "Section 1: Remittances 19.4% of GDP; decline could cut VAT (47.8% of net income)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Extreme weather events could damage ICT infrastructure and interrupt project activities.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Design ICT facilities to climate‑resilient standards, develop a Business Continuity Management System, and secure off‑site backups.",
      "evidence": "Section 6: Extreme weather events can cause infrastructure damage and economic losses, threatening project continuity."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Insufficient high‑level political commitment may cause reform stall or reversal.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Secure a formal MoU with the Ministry, embed reforms in the national development plan, and tie disbursements to political‑commitment milestones.",
      "evidence": "Section 32: Lack of sustained senior government commitment is a common reason for PFM reform failure."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Delays in establishing the PIU and adopting the POM could postpone cash flow and implementation.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Define a clear timeline for PIU establishment, make PIU set‑up a pre‑disbursement condition, and provide technical support for the POM.",
      "evidence": "Legal Covenants: No withdrawal until PIU is established and satisfactory to the Bank."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Procurement of ICT hardware not meeting energy‑efficiency standards may increase OPEX and environmental impact.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Include green procurement clauses, require life‑cycle cost analysis, and audit suppliers for energy‑efficiency compliance.",
      "evidence": "Subcomponent 2.4: All solutions will be energy‑efficient and electronic waste treated adequately."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Integration of peripheral financial systems may encounter data incompatibility and duplicate processing.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Create a common data model, use middleware for data exchange, and conduct interoperability testing during each phase.",
      "evidence": "Section 9: Limited interoperability between systems leads to manual processes and duplicate records."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Absence of robust data governance could lead to poor data quality and security breaches.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop a data‑governance framework, assign data owners, implement quality controls, and align with the ISMS.",
      "evidence": "Section 9: PFM data production lacks integrated approach; data governance policies are missing."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Capacity‑building gains may be lost due to staff turnover after project completion.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Institutionalize training modules, create a knowledge repository, certify staff, and embed positions in civil‑service career ladders.",
      "evidence": "Section 40: Permanent capacity building programs are designed to mitigate impact of talent turnover."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Complexity of implementing both COTS and custom software could cause cost overruns and delays.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Adopt a phased rollout, enforce strict scope control, monitor costs monthly, and allocate a contingency reserve.",
      "evidence": "Section 39: IFMIS reform projects tend to be costly and lengthy; realistic appraisal needed."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Insufficient citizen engagement may reduce public trust and limit use of transparency portals.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Improve portal UX, run public awareness campaigns, collect user feedback, and involve civil‑society groups in monitoring.",
      "evidence": "Section 39: Project will expand publication of user‑friendly fiscal data on public portals for citizen engagement."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Cross‑country coordination within the Smart PFM Community of Practice may be weak, limiting knowledge sharing.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Formalize the CoP MoU, appoint country liaison officers, schedule quarterly virtual meetings, and define shared deliverables.",
      "evidence": "Section 27: CoP will operate through clusters; MoU signed by Ministries of Finance of participating countries."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Climate‑budget tagging methodology may not be fully adopted, reducing climate‑responsive spending.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop clear climate‑tagging guidelines, integrate them into budgeting software, train budget officers, and track tagging compliance.",
      "evidence": "Section 31: Developing guidelines to prioritize low‑carbon investments and adopting climate tagging methodologies."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Expansion of the Treasury Single Account (TSA) could face legal or institutional resistance.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct legal review, align TSA expansion with IMF roadmap, engage treasury leadership early, and provide change‑management support.",
      "evidence": "Subcomponent 1.1: Expanding Treasury Single Account (TSA) coverage is part of reforms."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Financial management arrangements may not meet World Bank fiduciary standards, leading to audit findings.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Follow the World Bank FM Manual, engage an external audit firm as required, and implement corrective action plans promptly.",
      "evidence": "Section 52: FM arrangements assessed per World Bank Financial Management Manual for IPF operations."
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Fragmented and obsolete PFM information systems may cause integration failures and data inconsistencies.
